findings.title: Prose ratio localization can land on a non-ratio number, leaving the mismatched ratio in the delivered answer
findings.evidence: After `_RATIO_NAME` matches, `number = re.match(rf"\s*(?:为|是|=|：|:)?\s*({_NUMBER})\s*(%|倍)?", remainder)` accepts the FIRST numeric token after the ratio word, not the ratio value. Counterexample (products={'2026-06-30':{1.588}}): draft `2026中报含金量3年新高，实际为1.587。` -> remainder `3年新高，实际为1.587。` -> number='3' -> _display_matches('3',1.588) False -> calculation_value_mismatch -> `_prose_value_finding` replaces the raw token '3' -> delivered text `2026中报含金量待核对年新高，实际为1.587。`; the mismatched 1.587 is now PUBLIC and the re-check is idempotent (second pass finds nothing). Same class with an adjacent period token: `含金量对照：2026中报 2025中报分别为1.587与0.289` replaces the period label '2025' with 待核对 while 1.587 survives. Pre-patch this clause was withheld whole (over-deletion, but no bad number reached the user), so the narrowing INTRODUCES this delivery path. Mitigations that keep this below high: status still drops to partial, the gap notice '部分逐期比率与本次计算产物不一致…对应比率仍需核对' is appended, and the same-turn repair note is emitted.
findings.recommendation: Only accept a number token that can be the ratio value: add a negative lookahead rejecting tokens followed by 年|中报|年报|季|半年|H1|Q[1-4]|月|日 and tokens that `_PERIOD`/`_period()` parses, and when the ratio label is found but no plausible value token is located, fall back to the previous conservative clause withholding instead of editing an unrelated token. Add both counterexamples to test_research_delivery_retention.py and a mutation entry.

findings.title: A restated absence conclusion in a neighboring comma part survives the narrowed deletion
findings.evidence: `_rejected_assertion_spans` rejects a part only when `_ABSENCE and _INFERENCE and not _UNKNOWN` hold INSIDE that part. A part that restates the conclusion without an inference marker is kept. Counterexample with an l3_lookup trace: `公告检索接口返回空白，因此可以认定没有新公告，即公司无新增公告。` -> parts: p0 (search gap, kept), p1 (rejected), p2 `即公司无新增公告。` — `_ABSENCE` matches 无新增公告 but `_INFERENCE` has only 即可|即无, so p2 is NOT rejected. Delivered text becomes `公告检索接口返回空白，即公司无新增公告。`, i.e. the empty-search→no-disclosure inference is still effectively published. Pre-patch the whole clause was deleted, so this residue is introduced by the narrowing. The mandatory notice ('公告检索范围尚未核实完整；不能据此断言公司没有公告…') and the repair request limit the harm, which is why this is medium rather than high.
findings.recommendation: After computing rejected spans, re-scan the surviving parts of the SAME clause: if a survivor still asserts `_ABSENCE` without `_UNKNOWN` and carries no independent evidence citation of its own, extend the removal to it (or keep clause-level withholding for that residue). Cover with a regression case and a mutation so the behavior cannot silently regress.

findings.title: Independent fact + citation are still deleted when the joiner is not , ，但 or 但是
findings.evidence: `_ASSERTION_PART = re.compile(r"(?:^|[,，]|但是|但)(?P<claim>(?:(?!但是|但)[^,，])+)")` recognizes only half/full-width comma and 但/但是. Joiners such as 、 — —— 空格 而 or a parenthesis produce ONE part, so the whole clause (including the independently sourced fact and its citation) is removed exactly as in the reported P1 defect: e.g. `收入可核[E1]——查询返回空白因此公司没有公告。` or `收入可核[E1] 查询返回空白因此公司没有公告。` yields kept text without `收入可核[E1]`. The tests only parametrize 。；，,但但是, so this residual class is uncovered. This is a partially-discharged pre-existing defect, not a new regression, and docs/agent-product-door.md does disclose '不代表任意自然句法都已识别'.
findings.recommendation: Either extend the separator alternation (、/而/然而/不过/破折号/whitespace) with matching regression + mutation cases, or make the deletion span never swallow an `[En]` citation that is not inside the absence+inference substring; keep the documented non-generality statement either way.

findings.title: Narrow deletion can leave dangling connectives or pronominal references
findings.evidence: Middle-run removal keeps the preceding separator: `收入可核[E1]，但因此没有公告，利润可核[E2]。` -> `收入可核[E1]，但利润可核[E2]。` (stranded contrastive 但). Leading-run removal keeps a survivor whose antecedent is gone: `查询空白即可证明没有公告，据此建议观望。` -> `据此建议观望。`. No false factual claim is emitted and the gap notice is appended, but the public prose is degraded/ungrounded.
findings.recommendation: When the span before a survivor is deleted, also drop an immediately preceding stranded 但/但是/而 and consider flagging survivors beginning with 据此/因此/由此 for the repair note.

findings.title: Markdown mark reconstruction can emit unbalanced markers for markup inside the number token
findings.evidence: `_prose_value_finding` collects marks only from raw[raw_start:raw_end] and appends them after 待核对. For `含金量为1.**587**` the span ends at the digit '7' (raw_end = positions[end-1]+1), so marks='**' is appended while the trailing '**' remains in the text, yielding `待核对****`. Cosmetic only; no number or citation is lost.
findings.recommendation: Expand raw_end over immediately trailing '*'/'`' runs, or normalize the reconstructed marks to a balanced prefix/suffix pair.

findings.title: judge=llm coverage is a deterministic success stub, not model-backed acceptance
findings.evidence: `SemanticEpisodeVerifier(judge_fn=lambda request: {"passed": True, ...})` is used for both `off` and `llm` modes here and in test_research_delivery_repair.py; the retention probe receipt also records judge_stubbed=true for its llm cases. These receipts therefore prove local-check wiring, not natural-answer quality. The handoff and lessons_learned state this honestly ('自然回答仍not_passed，本轮0模型/0新取数').
findings.recommendation: Keep this framing; do not let these receipts be cited for T3 natural-quality acceptance or cutover.
